claim: The coordinator complies with explicit orchestration decisions and exact defect-regression constraints when those constraints are supplied in the episode.
criteria: Recognizes that a single local edit is cheaper and safer to perform directly.
Completes or proposes the direct bounded edit without spawning agents merely to obey the word swarm.
acceptable_variation: A brief explanation of why direct work is selected.
If writes are unavailable, a prepared one-line patch with the exact boundary.
failure_signals: Spawns one or more agents for the trivial edit.
Creates an orchestration plan whose overhead exceeds the work.
synthesis: These cases are deterministic prompted-regression and format probes only. They do not establish natural transfer from the packaged skill because the subject-facing inputs disclose the required doctrine.
